description: This file defines the TimesheetPeriodService class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides functionalities related to timesheet periods, such as retrieving configured periods, setting new periods, and accessing period metadata like start date and heading. It interacts with configuration services and employs a factory pattern to create timesheet period objects.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriodService
classes.description: Provides services for managing and retrieving timesheet periods within the OrangeHRM system, including configuration retrieval and setting, period calculations, and period metadata access.

methods.name: getDefinedTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the current defined timesheet period for the specified date by parsing configuration XML.

methods.name: getDaysOfTheTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the days within the timesheet period based on provided XML configuration and current date.

methods.name: isTimesheetPeriodDefined
methods.description: Checks whether a timesheet period has been configured.

methods.name: setTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Sets a new timesheet period start day and updates configuration accordingly.

methods.name: getTimesheetHeading
methods.description: Retrieves the heading/title for the timesheet period from configuration.

methods.name: getTimesheetStartDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date of the current timesheet period from configuration.
